interfaces.what: WLCSP9: D = 1.1700 / 1.2000 / 1.2300 mm (min/nom/max), E = 1.1900 / 1.2200 / 1.2500, A (overall height) = 0.5720 / 0.6120 / 0.6520, A1 (ball standoff) = 0.1720 / 0.2020 / 0.2320, A2 (body) = 0.3700 / 0.4100 / 0.4500, ball b = 0.2300 / 0.2600 / 0.2900, ball pitch e = 0.400 BSC in both axes — a 3 x 3 ball array. The frame is the package centre ON THE SEATING PLANE (z = 0 is the PCB land plane). WHICH VARIANT THIS DESIGN USES IS CANNOT DETERMINE: the same datasheet's ordering table offers ET7301B as WLCSP9 and ET7301BY as QFN14 2.5 x 2.5 mm, and no board file in this repo says which is fitted. What settles it: the Robot HAT's own fab package (electronics/robot-hat/) or a photograph of the board. `accepts` is EMPTY on purpose: an SMT land joint is connection:solder-smt, which is NOT on this shelf — naming it would dangle, and a dangling ref is a FAIL in bin/triad check, never a warning.
interfaces.source: READ OFF THE VENDOR'S OWN MECHANICAL DRAWING: ET7301B datasheet Rev 1.2, 'Package Dimension', WLCSP9 Package, COMMON DIMENSIONS table, PAGE 30 of 32 — the copy in this folder (current/datasheet.pdf), read 2026-09-02 (lane T)
